question: Does a profiler cycle mean the same clock cycle for every hardware unit?
documented_contract: Cycle metrics count cycles in the named unit clock domain. Active and elapsed denominators also belong to that unit.
test_recommendation: Collect l1tex__cycles_elapsed.avg.per_second alongside sm__cycles_elapsed.avg.per_second or gpc__cycles_elapsed.avg.per_second in one compatible collection pass. Preserve raw units and check whether rates agree.
competing_explanations: An extra shared package takes twoSMcycles because its unit processes at a lower clock rate.
An extra package costs twoSMcycles from service scheduling or dependency interactions even when unit clocks agree.
scope: The documented domain rule does not prove either explanation or expose internal pipeline stages.
